internal_hint: Paste an image directly into the web terminal using your browser's paste command.
complete: Image path inserted into the original pane. Press Enter only when you are ready.
unsupported: Paste a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.
failed: Image paste failed. Reconnect if needed, then try again.
disconnected: Connect to a writable terminal before pasting an image.
busy: An image is already being uploaded. Wait for it to finish.
too_large: The image exceeds this server's upload limit.
invalid_image: The file is not a valid supported image.
target_closed: The original pane has closed. Select another pane and paste again.
expired: The image paste request expired or the connection closed. Paste again.
unauthorized: The image paste request is no longer authorized. Reconnect and paste again.
read_only: This terminal is read-only. Open a writable terminal to paste an image.
